items.title: Steam forum ClickFix attacks infect gamers with XMRig cryptominers
items.summary: Steam discussion forums are being abused in ClickFix attacks that pretend to be fixes for game and computer problems but actually infect devices with cryptominers. [...]

items.title: Malvertising Sends Malware in Pieces, Then Makes the Browser Build the Executable
items.summary: A malvertising operation dubbed SourTrade is making victims' browsers build the final Windows executable themselves, using a legitimate Bun runtime as its base instead of serving one complete malicious file from a fixed URL. items.title: Malicious sites use JavaScript to build malware in browser memory
items.summary: A massive malvertising campaign is using fake Solana, Luno, and TradingView webpages with malicious JavaScript that instructs browsers to assemble malware directly in memory. [...]
